title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charvarius Ward (groin) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Charvarius Ward (groin) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Ward may not be available to play on Sunday, as he is officially questionable to play due to the groin injury that he's managing. Indianapolis' secondary will be weaker than usual if he's ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darius Slayton (knee) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Darius Slayton (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Slayton is a new addition to Indianapolis' injury report. He was added with a knee injury on Friday and is now considered questionable to play in Week 5. He only plays a depth role for the Colts right now, but his absence would still be less than ideal with Ashton Dulin (hamstring) out and Keenan Allen (groin) questionable to suit up against Pittsburgh.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyler Gordon (calf) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Kyler Gordon (calf) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: The young defensive back may be available to make his season debut on Sunday. He's officially considered questionable, but he was able to practice in full all week and seems to strongly be trending in the right direction. Chicago's secondary will see a nice boost if he's back in the lineup against Green Bay this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonah Jackson (ankle) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Jonah Jackson (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Jackson will be good to go for Sunday's game, which has been the expectation for a couple of days now. Chicago's offensive line will be nearly at full strength for this matchup against the Packers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: In a surprising move, Williams is officially considered questionable to play on Sunday. It was previously reported that Tyson Bagent is going to start for the Bears in Week 5, but now that is a little uncertain at this point. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on any updates about this situation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darnell Wright (ankle) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Darnell Wright (ankle) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Wright will be available to play on Sunday, despite missing a bit of practice time earlier in the week due to an ankle issue. His presence is great news for Chicago's offense ahead of a big divisional matchup against the Packers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joe Thuney (pec) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Joe Thuney (pec) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Thuney's pec injury turned out to be nothing serious and he is off of the injury report heading into the weekend. He will be good to go for a big game against the Packers on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Swift will be available to play on Sunday, despite missing practice earlier in the week due to a couple of different injuries. He should play without limitations and will see even more work than usual with Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) set to be sidelined against the Packers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jamel Dean (ankle) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Jamel Dean (ankle) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: The Steelers will be without Dean on Sunday as he continues to nurse an ankle injury that he's managing. Their secondary will be a lot weaker than usual if Jalen Ramsey (wrist) is also ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle (toe) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Dowdle has been out for multiple weeks due to a nagging toe issue, but he is officially questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. If he's able to, fantasy managers should expect him to once again eat into the workload of Jaylen Warren, who has been performing very well in the veteran's absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) is listed as questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: The veteran is officially considered questionable to play heading into the weekend. He's still managing a broken wrist, but he was able to play through it last week, so it seems more likely than not that he will do the same on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) out for Week 5
items.desc: DeShon Elliott (knee) will be out for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Elliott was able to practice in a limited fashion on Friday, but he's still not fully healthy and won't be available to play in Week 5. Pittsburgh's defense will be shorthanded for however long he remains out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle/foot) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Jeanty was not seen at practice on Friday. Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak didn't get into specifics on the foot injury. "It's that time of year. Guys are getting banged up." Jeanty will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenneth Murray Jr. clears concussion protocol
items.desc: Texans LB Kenneth Murray Jr. has cleared concussion protocol.
items.impact: Murray will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) not at practice Friday
items.desc: Ed Oliver was not seen at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Oliver will likely have to practice in some capacity on Saturday to have a chance of playing on Monday against the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dee Alford (ankle) not at practice Friday
items.desc: Dee Alford was not seen at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Alford is not expected to be sidelined long-term. He may still be out on Monday against the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) not at start of practice Friday
items.desc: DJ Moore was not seen at the start of practice on Friday.
items.impact: Moore did not practice on Thursday. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Saturday to have a chance to play on Monday against the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andy Dalton released by Eagles
items.desc: The Eagles are releasing QB Andy Dalton.
items.impact: Tanner McKee and Cole Payton will be the backups to Jalen Hurts moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alvin Kamara (back) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: Kamara was able to get in another practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) says he is 'ready to go' Sunday
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson told reporters he is "ready to go" for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: "I just got rolled up on," he said. "It was just a little scare I had. Just really making sure I was good, honestly... I've just been recovering. Got on the field, I ran. Ran around yesterday and I was full go today."

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Olave (foot) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Chris Olave is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: Olave was able to practice on both Thursday and Friday. He will remain a WR1 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Darrisaw (concussion) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Christian Darrisaw has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Darrisaw remains in the concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Jefferson was able to practice again on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday, but his status will still need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Addison (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Addison is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Addison was able to practice again on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday, but his status will still need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Greenard is likely on the wrong side of questionable heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drew Kendall (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Drew Kendall has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Kendall will be sidelined as expected. The Eagles offensive line takes another hit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zack Baun (concussion) will play Sunday
items.desc: Zack Baun will play on Sunday against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Baun will return after he was able to clear the concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) officially ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Barkley will miss at least one game as expected. Will Shipley becomes an RB2 as the likely lead back in the backfield. The Eagles also elevated Dameon Pierce to the active roster.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Smith will remain sidelined as expected. He remains week-to-week. The Eagles are getting Dallas Goedert back who should return to an immediate big role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) will play Sunday
items.desc: Dallas Goedert will return on Sunday against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Goedert will be back from a multi-week absence. He should be a borderline TE1 with DeVonta Smith and Saquon Barkley both still ruled out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) will play Sunday
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Malik Nabers will be "ready to play" on Sunday.
items.impact: Nabers is coming off a big performance last week against the Cardinals. He should remain in fantasy lineups this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Hendrickson didn't practice this week after undergoing surgery late last week. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Mason (thumb) expected to return in Week 7
items.desc: Vikings RB Jordan Mason is expected to return for Minnesota's Week 7 game.
items.impact: Mason is expected to return after the Vikings bye week. He will figure to return to a committee with Aaron Jones.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Tee Higgins is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Higgins was able to get in some work during practice on Friday. His status will have to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase remains in concussion protocol
items.desc: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Ja'Marr Chase remains in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Chase was in uniform during practice on Friday. He will have till Saturday to clear all protocols in time for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) will play Sunday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo told reporters he will play on Sunday against the Commanders.
items.impact: Skattebo said he had a "little muscle tightness" in his shoulder. It's why he wore a red no-contact jersey on Wednesday. He'll remain a steady RB2 play.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ryan Flournoy goes for 90 yards in loss
items.desc: Ryan Flournoy caught three of four targets for 90 yards in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs on Thursday.
items.impact: Flournoy stepped in and made some big plays while operating as the Cowboys' WR2/3 on Thursday with CeeDee Lamb in and out of the lineup due to injury. If Lamb or George Pickens were to miss any time, Flournoy would be a primary pickup.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Wingard (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Wingard has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Wingard will be sidelined with a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) trending in right direction for Sunday
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Jeremiyah Love has moved around well this week.
items.impact: Love will continue to manage his ankle injury. He appears likely to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Lions.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: George Pickens goes off against Tampa secondary
items.desc: George Pickens caught 9 of 13 targets for 130 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs on Thursday.
items.impact: Pickens had himself a night on Thursday, partially spurred on by the loss of CeeDee Lamb for a good portion of the game. Pickens was bound to connect with Dak Prescott on a deep shot at some point, given all the different times they had attempted to do so before. He had a nice touchdown grab with his typical no-separation, "Moss" -ing style. Pickens has been an ok asset for fantasy, but certainly not the WR1 like he was last year.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Huntley to start for Ravens Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Huntley will start for the Ravens on Sunday against the Falcons.
items.impact: Huntley will get the spot start with Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out. He holds some intrigue as a QB2 in 2-QB and superflex leagues.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: This was the expectation all week and it is now official. It will be Tyler Huntley getting the start Sunday night against Michael Penix Jr. and Atlanta.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Javonte Williams shut down in loss to Bucs
items.desc: Javonte Williams ran 12 times for 45 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to Tampa Bay. He also caught two of three targets for 17 yards.
items.impact: Williams had some early success on Thursday, culminating in his early touchdown plunge on the Cowboys' first drive. However, he didn't get much going after that, as the Dallas offense stalled completely until the fourth quarter. He's not particularly efficient, but the volume is there, and he should be a viable RB2 most weeks.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Dak Prescott throws for 316 yards in loss
items.desc: Dak Prescott completed 24 of 42 passes for 316 yards and a touchdown with two picks in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs.
items.impact: It was not Dak's best showing, struggling against a secondary that had been picked on up to this point in the season. He will look to right the ship against the Packers on Sunday Night Football a little over a week from now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brenden Schooler to be activated Sunday
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said that Brenden Schooler will come off the PUP list and make his debut on Sunday against the Raidersb
items.impact: Schooler will be making his season debut.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Reggie Gilliam (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Reggie Gilliam was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: The Patriots will be without their fullback on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mack Hollins (calf) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Mack Hollins has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Hollins will miss at least one game after leaving last week early. Romeo Doubs was the Patriots wide receiver who was able to take advantage last week following his absence.
